scope: 31 curated nooks. Existing custom track is preserved separately. No active unlock thresholds or names are changed by this file.

research.scope: Qualitative product-pattern research, not a representative study of students or StudyTok audiences.

sources.title: LifeAt: Focus with others
sources.observed: Shared environments and coordinated focus sessions are explicit product features.
sources.designInference: Put optional small-group sessions beside the study task, without copying video/chat clutter.

sources.title: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions, official developer listing
sources.observed: The product combines a customizable setting, ambient audio, productivity tools and collectible companions.
sources.designInference: Reward specificity and lasting personalization matter more than a generic XP counter. No creature animation is copied.

sources.title: Virtual Cottage 2, official developer listing
sources.observed: The developer describes customizable decor, shared cottages, minimal social reactions and adjustable focus tools.
sources.designInference: Let people keep a personal space and quietly study together; avoid competitive interruption.

sources.title: Aesthetic school focused study, creator listing on Notion
sources.observed: The creator pairs academic organization and focus controls with an anime-influenced visual style.
sources.designInference: The visual identity should frame notes and study controls rather than replace them.

sources.title: Aesthetic Light Academia School Planner, creator listing on Notion
sources.observed: This listing provides a distinct light-academia interpretation of a student planner.
sources.designInference: Keep multiple aesthetics discoverable; do not assume every student wants the same dark fantasy style.

sources.title: Forest, official product site
sources.observed: Forest visualizes completed focus with a lasting tree collection and also describes failure and loss mechanics.
sources.designInference: Retain the legible record of time; Nooks deliberately omits decay, loss and group punishment.

creditContract.description: Verified timer accounting only; not verified attention or comprehension.
creditContract.rounding: compare integer seconds; round remaining minutes up only for display
creditContract.multipleDevices: one active session per account; account-wide overlap cannot earn twice
creditContract.creditOrigin: immutable nookId and roomId captured at start; child views credit the parent track

displayContract.assemblyRule: Only includes owned source pieces; the assembly consumes one slot. Components remain in inventory, with no duplicates inside the same equipped assembly.
displayContract.growthRule: Earned variants remain selectable. Changing stages replaces the same slot and never consumes or destroys a stage.
displayContract.roomSwitchRule: Placements save per nook and restore on return; inventory and progress do not transfer between unrelated tracks.
displayContract.scenePlacement: Only authored, reviewed anchors with perspective, occlusion and responsive crop transforms. Until approved, keep objects in the collection viewer; do not overlay them on scenery.
displayContract.legacyCreatures: Existing cat, dog, fox, egg and dragon rewards remain still illustrations/figurines, not roaming pets.
displayContract.sound: Explicit Play only; mute, pause and volume always accessible. No autoplay on unlock or entry.
displayContract.reducedMotion: Static equivalent of every effect; animations never convey exclusive information.

disclosureContract.default: Show exact total focus threshold, category and next-goal time for every released milestone.
disclosureContract.surprises: Optional visual/name concealment only; a Reveal details control shows the contents without spending or studying. Deterministic rewards, never loot boxes.
disclosureContract.unreleased: Do not advertise an unready asset as earnable. Once released, previously accumulated eligible time counts.
disclosureContract.completion: Display completion neutrally; no infinite task, streak punishment or pressure to remain.

stateContract.claimRule: Released threshold awards are granted atomically with completed focus accounting or a migration; no client clock or client-provided duration is trusted.
stateContract.presentationRule: available/equipped are derived from immutable unlock grants plus placement records; collection visibility can survive asset failure.
stateContract.nextGoalRule: First released, unowned milestone by threshold; remainingSeconds=max(0,thresholdSeconds-creditedSeconds). Exclude future asset work from the next-goal promise.

migration.activation: disabled until assets, schema and migration are validated
migration.existingIds: Never rename room IDs or reward IDs. Display labels are aliases only.
migration.existingAwards: Backfill immutable grants for every existing earned reward and every recorded placed reward before changing any catalog. Union with prior explicit grants; never relock.
migration.newAwards: After a milestone is released, compare existing cumulative eligible seconds and grant it retroactively. No reset to zero and no repeat effort.
migration.activeSessions: Capture the version at session start; later path revisions cannot redirect or subtract credit.
migration.rollback: Disable v2 presentation but preserve grants, source focus ledger and placements. Never delete history to roll back.
migration.custom: Do not partition the existing custom aggregate among new creator nooks without evidence. Keep its legacy track; new creator instances receive new stable IDs and start their own eligible ledger.
